value: **Direct Callouts & Context**: "Findings suggest that reflection quality, not quantity, distinguishes self -efficacy trajectories and that deliberately scaffolding evaluative, forward -looking reflection could potentially support self -efficacy growth in makerspaces." | "By linking these patterns to outcomes, the study identifies how reflection organization supports or undermines self -efficacy development and informs strategies for scaffolding more productive reflective practice in makerspaces." | "Our results suggest that evaluative, forward- looking reflection serves as an internal scaffold that helps students reframe obstacles as learning experiences."
